**Test image observations:**
- Corn leaf held close-up, predominantly healthy green
- Subtle pale/whitish fine streaks running parallel to the leaf veins
- One tiny dark spot visible in the center-left area
- No major lesions, necrosis, or pustules

**Key features analysis:**
- The faint pale streaking along the veins is the most notable visual pattern
- Streaks are narrow and run lengthwise parallel to the midrib — characteristic of Maize streak virus
- The reference image for Maize_streak_virus confirms this pattern: alternating green and pale/yellow narrow stripes along the veins
- No rust pustules (rules out Common/Southern rust), no large gray/tan lesions (rules out Northern corn leaf blight/Gray leaf spot), no tar-like spots (rules out Tar_spot)
- The symptoms appear early/mild stage but the streaking pattern is consistent with Maize streak virus
